pattern: proxy finish LIGHT (proxy_finish.py stage_light + proxy_finish_light.py): the frozen Pixal3D sheet proxy kept as generated (geometry + texture), made watertight, decimated, baked, optionally reposed with bones

refloor.why: sheet_proxy already floored the proxy at the tendril base (verts below z 0.02 span x -0.93..1.85, y -1.71..1.13: the ground tendrils, no tail curl / shadow plate): the floor stays at the lowest tendril contact (whole-body window, pct 0), then x(5.43 / 5.415) to the sheet front height (front 5.43 u vs side 5.69 u, +4.8 %: the side view's crown spike is drawn taller; the front wins, the brief's rule)

dense.why: the DECOY HEAD: crown points + brim + face (proxy sha 09e4004f slabs z 4.6..5.4: x -0.68..1.05, y -1.10..0.15; crown tip (-0.22, 0.02, 5.415)); vg_weight 0.3 so the eye box below can sit denser
the two yellow decoy EYES (proxy texture yellow samples: x 0.07..0.18 / 0.28..0.39, y -1.02..-0.90, z 4.75..4.89): held densest so the glow core lands on its own faces
the UPPER FANG rows + upper lip (cream samples z 3..4.6 at y -1.47..-0.46, red lip z 4.0..4.6): teeth stay separate points
the LOWER FANG rows + lower lip (cream samples z 0..2 at y -1.67..-1.10, red lip z 0..1 y -1.59..-1.05)
the +x arm's red CLAW tips (red clusters (1.60, -0.58, 1.72), (2.28, -0.19, 2.49))

light.ao_why: vulture_creature / crystal_canine lessons: AO from the watertight low (tendril soup inner shells black-hole AO rays) with a 0.6 u ray (only real crevices darken; the maw interior is a real crevice and darkens)
light.bake_drop_interior_why: vulture_creature lesson: proxy faces with solid on both sides (buried tendril shells) left out of the albedo bake source
light.uv_island_margin_why: vulture_creature lesson: a tendril low unwraps into thousands of islands; margin 0.001 keeps the albedo detail

glow3d.name: decoy_eyes_core
glow3d.why: GLOW = the decoy head's two yellow eyes only (spec): faces at the proxy's own eye texels (yellow clusters (0.09, -0.97, 4.86) / (0.335, -0.96, 4.80)) whose baked albedo is bright yellow -> eye_glow (sheet eye / tooth chip 252,234,167). The maw is NOT emissive

rig.spine_why: base (floor centre, behind the maw: the back half y 0.3..1.4 is solid down to the floor) -> body -> the JAW HINGE (0, 0.6, 2.45: behind the throat; the maw's deepest interior at x 0 is y 0..0.5, z 1.4..3.3) -> upper_jaw runs up-forward through the upper jaw mass to behind the upper fangs (cream z 3.0..4.4 at y -1.1..-1.3) -> crown = the DECOY HEAD (z 4.6..5.4), which rides on the upper jaw

chains.name: jaw_lower
chains.why: the LOWER JAW: hinge just under the upper jaw's (0, 0.6, 2.3) -> under the throat floor -> behind the lower fang row / lower lip (cream z 0.4..1.9 at y -1.4..-1.1, red lip y -1.45). A jaw-close = upper_jaw pitched down + jaw_lower pitched up about the hinge (kind 'leg': the kit's idle / walk give a leg chain no motion at leg_swing 0, so the lower jaw stays still in the placeholder clips; v1 kind 'jaw' swayed it +-3 deg and dipped the lower lip / front tendrils 0.23 u below the floor)

chains.name: arm
chains.why: the reaching tendril ARMS: shoulder inside the body side (z 3.05) out to the claw ends (+x claws (1.60, -0.58, 1.72) / (2.28, -0.19, 2.49); -x claws (-2.13, -0.99, 1.43) / (-2.11, -1.38, 2.53)); the proxy's -x arm reaches ~0.5 u further forward (it copies the sheet side view's near arm), so points_R follow it

chains.name: horn
chains.why: the red-tipped upper-body spike tendrils (red tips (1.49, 0.55, 4.42) / (-1.86, 0.85, 4.09)): ride on the upper jaw

chains.name: tendril
chains.why: the ground TENDRILS spreading to the sides (floor band z < 0.35 spans x -2.5..2.2): sway in idle, trail in the glide

rig.chains_why: L points measured on the +x side; the contract rig mirrors them for .R (the proxy's -x arm reaches ~0.5 u further forward, copying the sheet side view's near arm: no repose, the front view reads symmetric)

clips.why: PLACEHOLDER (the artist has not said how the true form moves): idle = the spine breathe (upper_jaw / crown pitch +-1.5 deg: a slow breathing of the open maw) + the kit's chain sway (arms, horns, ground tendrils); walk = the kit's in-place cycle as a GLIDE placeholder (no legs: bob 0.006 H, roll 1.5, arm swing 6, tendrils trail); the game slides the root. chomp / close / transform_in: clips.extra (below)
clips.extra_why: v1.1 (kit clips.extra, keyed world poses, smoothstep): chomp 24 f cyclic (open -> shut at f8, hold to f11 -> open; CLOSED = upper_jaw +44 / jaw_lower.0 -18 deg world X, the mouth-states probe: lip-rim gap 0.13 u of 2.34), close 16 f non-looping (open -> CLOSED, held on the last frame), transform_in 48 f non-looping (f0: base sunk 0.6 H below the floor with the ground tendrils counter-lifted onto it, jaws shut, arms folded down 35 deg; f30 risen with the jaws shut; f48 the rest pose). PLACEHOLDER

refloor.rule: sheet_proxy put the floor at the lowest point (a tail curl): the feet hung z0 above it; floor moved to the feet, then scaled to the sheet front height

solid.rule: LIGHT: watertight remesh only (no smoothing / straighten / symmetrise / cuts); the surface sits min_half_thickness x step = 0.0091 u outside the proxy

colour.mode: light: the proxy texture as generated

high.rule: marching tets of the whole remesh grid (no mirror)

low.method: collapse decimation: uniform to 300000, then 20000 with the dense boxes calibrated

dense.rule: dense boxes weighted 0.02 (vs 1) in the collapse decimation; the factor bisected until the boxes hold density x the rest's triangles per area

ao_fill.rule: AO < below = a bake origin inside the proxy soup: refilled from the covered valid 3x3 neighbours ring by ring (opt-in light.ao_fill_below)

bake.source: the proxy mesh itself (not the remesh)

rows.why: GLOW = the decoy head's two yellow eyes only (spec): faces at the proxy's own eye texels (yellow clusters (0.09, -0.97, 4.86) / (0.335, -0.96, 4.80)) whose baked albedo is bright yellow -> eye_glow (sheet eye / tooth chip 252,234,167). The maw is NOT emissive

glow3d.rule: faces -> glow palette regions (emission -> Glow -> Emission Color); rgb white keeps the baked albedo

mirror.rule: every vertex mirrored in X about the plane -> distance to the nearest surface (0 = exactly symmetric)

floor.rule: stage 1 floored the FEET at z 0; the centring puts the lowest point at 0

facing.rule: shell centroid -> the front-most midline point of the shell (proxy finish default)

mirror.rule: every vertex mirrored in X about the plane -> distance to the nearest surface (0 = exactly symmetric)
